messages:
alex: FYI starting a scoped deploy (wave-79 dry-run) focused on API header unification + router path affinity. quiet window 01:00-02:00 UTC. keeping change-window short.
mina: runtime aware 1 2 small memory allocator tweak packaged in this wave. shouldn't affect KV cache but i'll watch eviction logs.
jamal: router: enabling path-affinity flag in staging canary. will route 2% and validate session stickiness.
tiago: console: feature-flag for header name mapping ready, will keep old mapping for 72h behind a flag.
alex: deploybot preflight queued. note: we're pinning model-runtime v2.4.1 in this wave to avoid rollover risk.
deploybot: Wave 79 dry-run: preflight OK. Artifacts built: images: api:v79, runtime:v2.4.1, router:v1.9. Use `@deploybot advance 79 --canary` to proceed.
ops-jen: reminder: rollback triggers: backend 5xx >1.5% sustained for 3m OR p95 latency increase >20% for 5m. Ops monitors enabled.
mina: starting runtime smoke with small qps ramp. checking GC and eviction order under churn.
jamal: routing smoke started. seeing consistent affinity, no session leakage so far.
tiago: console toggled in staging. old and new header mapping both accepted when header=Legacy|Unified.
mina: runtime: observed two rapid evictions in one host under heavy churn, investigating whether allocator tweak influenced timing.
jamal: router: noticed 0.2% of requests took fallback route; correlating with the host that had rapid evicts.
alex: flagging that host for deeper diag, keep canary running but don't promote yet.
deploybot: Wave 79: canary paused by manual hold. Use `@deploybot resume 79` after fixes.
ops-jen: good catch. please add rollback note: pin to runtime v2.4.0 if eviction pattern recurs.
mina: narrowed root cause 2 allocator boundary check + eviction race when concurrent prefetches happen. pushing a hotfix candidate (runtime:v2.4.1-hotfix).
jamal: router: after hotfix rolled to that host, fallback rate dropped to 0.01%. affinity stable.
tiago: console: no user-facing errors during the pause. cleans.
alex: good. replacing the pinned runtime in the wave with hotfix image and resuming canary when ready.
deploybot: Wave 79: image updated runtime->v2.4.1-hotfix. Awaiting manual resume.
mina: running targeted stress on fixed host. eviction ordering clean. GC pause short.
jamal: router reports steady routing; no resurgence of fallback.
alex: resuming canary now. if green for 10m we go broad staging.
deploybot: Wave 79: resumed to canary. Monitoring window 10m.
ops-jen: temporarily relax infra flapping alerts; manual abort still honored.
mina: after 8m, metrics stable. no extra 5xx.
jamal: p95 latency unchanged.
tiago: console telemetry shows header mapping flag usage at 12% for staging clients. good for rollout metrics.
alex: moving to broad staging. note for release notes: add bullets for runtime hotfix, router affinity validation, API header pinning.
deploybot: Wave 79: advanced to broad staging. Canary-id cw-79-stg-broad. Auto-rollback active.
ops-jen: watch window 15m. if any of the rollback triggers fire, initiate pin/rollback and notify all teams.
mina: adding line to release-note draft: "runtime: fixed eviction race under prefetch; hotfix v2.4.1-hotfix validated in staging"
jamal: adding: "router: path-affinity validated; transient fallback correlated to single-host eviction, resolved by runtime hotfix"
tiago: adding: "console: header mapping feature-flag enabled; legacy mapping maintained for 72h"
alex: thanks. dry-run outcome depends on broad staging results; please post any anomalies immediately in this thread.
ops-jen: post-check: create operational runbook step to pin to v2.4.0 if similar eviction reappears in prod.
deploybot: Wave 79: broad staging complete. Dry-run outcome: partial success (issue detected and fixed mid-run). Artifacts: s3://deploy-artifacts/wave79/dryrun/
alex: marking wave-79 as dry-run-fixed. scheduling a brief postmortem doc and a prod-cutover sync next Tue. Thanks all.
